## Maintainer Checklist

- [ ] Change is tied to one issue.
- [ ] Scope is small and reviewable.
- [ ] Hardware-facing changes include board, wiring, toolchain, expected behavior, and observed behavior.
- [ ] Unverified hardware behavior is marked clearly.
- [ ] Source/vendor files are not changed unless the PR intentionally explains why.
- [ ] No unrelated formatting or cleanup is bundled in.
